thread:
sarah (AE): Kickoff: CosmosHealth POC — they want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, and tenant slicing by subdomain. Security has a long questionnaire. Can we sync 2pm PST today? Need answers before Wed to keep the timeline.

mike (SE): 2pm works. Quick q: do they require SP-initiated only or both SP/IdP? Also, any hard requirement on NameID format (email vs persistent)?

harpreet (Security): @sarah good call. High-level security asks: SAML assertion encryption optional, signed assertions required, ACS endpoints must support HTTPS + HSTS, audit logs for auth events retained 1 year, support for SCIM provisioning with delta and bulk, SCIM rate limits and retry semantics, and ability to map Okta groups->our RBAC roles. Also: proof of domain ownership (DNS TXT) for tenant binding.

aj (Solutions): Added: they asked about tenant slicing — they want different teams in the same company to have isolated namespaces (subdomain.company.com) and per-tenant RBAC. Is that isolation at routing layer or separate orgs?

mike (SE): We support both approaches: single-tenant-per-org (strong isolation) or multi-tenant with subdomain routing + strict RBAC. For POC we can demo subdomain routing with tenant claims in SAML (`tenant` attribute) and SCIM `emails[0].value` mapping.

sarah (AE): Pricing wrinkle: they asked if SCIM & dedicated RBAC mapping requires Dedicated (reserved capacity) or available on Hosted with enterprise plan?

mike (SE): Core SCIM provisioning (basic) is available on Hosted enterprise. SCIM bulk + high throughput provisioning and guaranteed sync windows are typically part of Dedicated or higher enterprise add-on. RBAC mapping config + audit retention beyond default is an add-on. I'll flag for pricing.

harpreet (Security): Also verify KMS integration for key management (customer-managed keys/HSM) — that's a blocker for their compliance team. They'll need key rotation and import logs.

aj (Solutions): Customer asked about SCIM attribute mapping example — I'll paste a quick sample mapping they can send to Okta.

aj (Solutions): ```json
{ "scimMapping": { "userName": "emails[0].value", "displayName": "name.formatted", "roles": "groups", "tenant": "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:orgUnit" } }
```

mike (SE): For SAML metadata, ACS + EntityID examples below — send this to their IdP admin: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://cosmos.redwood-inference.example/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://cosmos.redwood-inference.example/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

sarah (AE): Action items: 1) @mike confirm whether SCIM delta + bulk is available on hosted for demo (or we need a temp Dedicated eval) 2) @harpreet we'll send the security questionnaire now 3) @aj prepare mapping doc + sample metadata to send to customer.

mike (SE): I can enable a hosted-ish demo with increased SCIM rate limits for the POC (temporary). If the customer needs guaranteed SLA for provisioning, we'll propose Dedicated in the quote.

harpreet (Security): I'll start the questionnaire — main open items that will block are KMS/HSM, audit retention policy, and proof of tenant isolation. If they accept subdomain routing with DNS TXT proof + our audit guarantees, that should clear most items.

sarah (AE): Thanks. I'll book 2pm PST and include the IdP admin + Okta engineer. Also adding pricing stub: POC discounts available; if they sign a 12-month reserved capacity we can include SCIM bulk and extended audit retention in the contract.

redwood-deploy-bot: Reminder: provisioning-demo cluster will be torn down in 72h unless extended.

aj (Solutions): I'll draft an email to send after the call with the mapping examples, SAML metadata, and the questionnaire link. Anyone want to add specifics to that email?

mike (SE): Add note about fallback auth: if SAML fails fallback to host tokens for support, and include example SAML troubleshooting steps (assertion viewer, clock skew checks).

harpreet (Security): Add SLA note: for POC we deliver best-effort, but production will require contract for guaranteed incident response and retention.

sarah (AE): Perfect — see you all 2pm. I'll post the calendar and include the questionnaire link in the invite. :thumbsup:
